newsitem.title: RUSSIA: LUKoil new prefs to be used only for new assets.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil new prefs to be used only for new assets.

text.p: Russian oil producer LUKoil said on Thursday that a planned issue of 10 million preferred shares would be used exclusively to acquire new assets.
Spokesman Pyotr Neyev said the new shares would be used in making new acquisitions. One possibility would be to pay for such assets with the new shares, in effect making a share swap.
"There will not be a dilution of shares because there will be new acquisitions and new assets," spokesman Pyotr Neyev told Reuters.
LUKoil's board will propose shareholders authorise 10 million new preferred shares with 25 rouble par value, to be issued at the discretion of the board, at the annual meeting on June 5, he said.
Neyev said the board would probably issue the shares soon after the meeting but not trade them immediately.
"If they authorise the issue it will be issued shortly after the meeting. But the shares will be reserved for expedient projects."
He said the shares would not be swapped with subsidiaries as part of LUKoil's consolidation plan.

LUKoil increased its capital by about 4.5 percent with issues of 19.8 million ordinary shares and 12.2 million preferred shares on January 20 as part of a plan to convert subsidiaries' shares. Neyev said the swap is nearly over.
LUKoil currently has 77.2 million preferred shares which represent 10.34 percent of authorised capital.
